name: tutytv-modernization
description: Incremental modular architecture for TutyTV (TypeScript + Vite)

scripts.build:web: node scripts/build-web.mjs && vite build --config vite.core.web.config.ts && vite build --config vite.ui.web.config.ts
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts vite.core.config.ts vite.core.web.config.ts vite.ui.config.ts vite.ui.web.config.ts vite.web.config.ts vite.webos.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:legacy && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.build:ipk: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:ui && cd source && ./tools/build-ipk.sh
